summary: Polomar Health Services filed an 8-K regarding a waiver and amendment to its Agreement and Plan of Merger with Altanine, Inc., originally dated July 23, 2025. The parties waived conditions including S-4 effectiveness, Nasdaq listing approval, Altanine's performance, a reverse stock split for a $10 stock price, and $25 million equity credit line. They amended Section 6.2(e) to require Polomar to deliver audited 2024 and 2025 financials prior to closing. No price per share, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The deal is structured as a reverse merger with Altanine as acquirer. Watch for Nasdaq approval and financial delivery as key milestones.
